lines.zh: 我背着大壳，一步一步走。
lines.en: I carry my great shell, step by step.

lines.zh: 四只脚踩得很慢，壳在晃。
lines.en: Four feet move slowly; the shell sways.
I go around the roots in the wood.
The coral on my shell scrapes the leaves.

lines.zh: 我在丛林里找有水的地方。
lines.en: I look for water in the jungle.

lines.zh: 我身体的重量压弯了草。
lines.en: My weight bends the grass.
I stop and lower my head.
I drag the shell forward step by step.
I glance back at my anchor.
Not fast, but never aimless.
My claws grip the mud.
I settle in my shell and breathe slowly.
A thin moss has grown on my shell.
I draw my head in a little.
I rub my feet in the mud.
This jungle is very damp.
My eyelids sink slowly.
A small sound comes from inside the shell.
I poke my head out of the shell.
Near my anchor, I am secure.
I pull back into my shell.
This place is quiet enough.
You are shorter than my shell.
I keep to this area.
Are you my tamer?
I have a shell. No need to fear.
Are you looking at my back?
I move slowly. Do not rush me.

lines.zh: 这一片丛林是我的地盘。
lines.en: This patch of jungle is mine.
I smell water.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我的壳纹里。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across the ridges of my shell.
This shell of mine is very heavy.
You remind me of something.
If you sit, I will follow.
I do not talk much.
Where are you going?
You are standing by the anchor.
Muddy water seeps into the crack.
I pull my neck in but barely retreat.
I pull my neck in a little.
The flesh stings a little.
The shell held. I am all right.
I pull my neck into the shell.
This will heal slowly.
I keep it in and stay quiet.
You have annoyed me.
Is that a pool of water?
Put it where I can reach.
If it is for me, let me sniff it first.
That thing in your hand is bright.
I shuffle slowly. Do not rush.
Do not hold it over my back.
I move very slowly.
Wait for me a moment.
With this shell on my back, I cannot reach.
I will take that much.
I give ground slowly.
My shell is too heavy to turn quickly.
Make way for this shell.
That nudge did not even rock my shell.
Your shoulder hit the coral.
My foot slipped.
Do not push the shell on my back.
All four feet are planted.
I already have a tamer.
That is not mine to decide.
This shell of mine is very heavy.
Keep some distance from me.
I must guard my anchor first.
My shell has room only for my master.
I do everything slowly.
Let me rest a moment.
I have withdrawn into my shell.
A wet stone on the ground.
I hook it over with a claw.
My shell blocks my view.
Lowering my head is difficult.
I hook it to one side.
This one might be useful.
I cannot scoop it up.
Better to give it to my tamer.
My claws are too blunt.
I have my eye on you.
Turning my shell takes a while.
I will use the ranged move.
Stones rise around me.
I have counted three breaths.
All four feet are set.
There is no cover here.
I come slowly, but I come.
Moving now. Do not stand dazed.
I close in an inch at a time.
Stones on the ground begin to move.
You moved behind a tree.
My shell blocks half the path.
I hide half my shell behind the roots.
Closer for a look.
The stones hover higher.
Stop right in this spot.
The stones fly after me.
A swipe of my foreclaw.
The shell boomed with that one.
My shell rim strikes your knee.
The shell's rim scraped you.
Moss grows on my shell.
A stone strikes your shoulder.
I turn with effort.
That one was heavy enough.
You are pushed to the water's edge.
I stop and catch my breath.
I climb out of the shallows.
Water and moss all over my shell.
This jungle suits me.
I raise my head slowly.
First I check the anchor.
Water from the trees lands on my shell.
I move very slowly.
Something living moves nearby.
I square up my four feet.
There is some water here.
I retract my neck a little.
Fire on my shell. Very hot.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下来，壳先着地。
lines.en: I slid down; the shell landed first.
My shell rim cracks against stone with a dull thud.
An arrow sticks in my shell.
This light passed through my shell.
The moss is gone and my shell feels hollow.

lines.zh: 电打在我的壳上，全身一震。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and I jolt.
Even my shell cannot stop this.
